speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Renal Cell Carcinoma (Right Kidney)

I have reviewed your history of recurrent UTIs and the presence of hematuria with flank pain. Given your age and the combination of these symptoms, I am concerned about a possible renal malignancy rather than just an infection. I would like to order imaging to confirm this suspicion.
